description: This source file is a Perl script for managing package metadata and configurations in a build system, likely for OpenWrt or similar embedded Linux distributions. It includes functions for version comparison, dependency resolution, package configuration generation, and producing JSON reports of package manifests, along with various utilities for handling package dependencies, conflicts, and metadata.

methods.name: version_to_num
methods.description: Converts a version string like '1.2.3' into a numerical value for comparison.

methods.name: version_filter_list
methods.description: Filters a list of version strings based on comparison with a specified version.

methods.name: gen_kconfig_overrides
methods.description: Generates overridden kernel configuration options based on package and build system configs.

methods.name: __find_package_dep
methods.description: Recursively checks if a package depends on a given package.

methods.name: find_package_dep
methods.description: Wrapper to avoid infinite recursion when checking package dependencies.

methods.name: package_depends
methods.description: Determines dependency relations between two packages (depends or reverse).

methods.name: mconf_depends
methods.description: Generates dependency condition strings for package build configurations.

methods.name: mconf_conflicts
methods.description: Generates conflict condition strings for packages.

methods.name: add_implicit_provides_conflicts
methods.description: Adds conflict declarations for non-default package providers to ensure proper dependency resolution.

methods.name: print_package_config_category
methods.description: Outputs package configuration options grouped under a category or menu.

methods.name: print_package_overrides
methods.description: Outputs package override configurations if any.

methods.name: gen_package_config
methods.description: Generates the overall package configuration including categories and options.

methods.name: and_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical AND condition into a makefile expression.

methods.name: gen_condition
methods.description: Converts a logical OR condition into a makefile expression.

methods.name: get_conditional_dep
methods.description: Wraps dependency strings with conditional expressions based on a specified condition.

methods.name: gen_package_mk
methods.description: Generates the Makefile snippets defining package build dependencies and variants.

methods.name: gen_package_source
methods.description: Outputs source file information for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_auxiliary
methods.description: Outputs auxiliary variables like repository info and dependencies.

methods.name: gen_package_license
methods.description: Produces license information for each package, optionally including license files.

methods.name: gen_version_filtered_list
methods.description: Filters and displays version strings based on a specified patch version.

methods.name: gen_usergroup_list
methods.description: Outputs user and group assignment for packages.

methods.name: gen_package_manifest_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON array of package metadata suitable for external tools.

methods.name: image_manifest_packages
methods.description: Reads an image manifest file and extracts package names.

methods.name: dump_cyclonedxsbom_json
methods.description: Constructs and encodes a CycloneDX SBOM JSON document given components.

methods.name: gen_image_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON for the image based on package manifests and image package list.

methods.name: gen_package_cyclonedxsbom
methods.description: Generates a CycloneDX SBOM JSON from a package manifest.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Dispatches command line arguments to specific generation functions.
